linux-gfx942.blocked_reason: HIP RT 3.1.0.cb09c56 hangs the GPU in its own BVH Collapse kernel: the persistent-task loop exits only on m_referenceCount == referenceCount and the emitted count overshoots, so lanes spin forever. Reproduces from about 42 surfel disks up, data dependent, with LBVH, LBVH-without-pairing and PLOC alike (they share the kernel). Relaxing the test to >= terminates and traces correctly, which proves the overshoot, but referenceIndices is sized to the primitive count so it would also be writing past that buffer -- the miscount has to be found before anything ships. Extension builds and small scenes trace at head; the GPU gate cannot be met until this is fixed.

intake.duplicate_effort: none outside MOAT: no AMD-Ecosystem/ROCm repo, no amd/rocm/hip mention upstream, no AMD forks; the only AMD work is our own EnvGS Stage 2
intake.summary: Differentiable 2D-Gaussian OptiX ray tracer (MIT, verified by reading LICENSE; GitHub misreports NOASSERTION). Already rewritten onto HIPRT and GPU-validated under EnvGS Stage 2 -- taking it up buys a separate PR route to xbillowy, not new porting. Decided by two things: 9 NVIDIA-proprietary headers in the upstream OptiX submodule need a ruling, and moat-port vendors HIPRT/Orochi incl. a 1.9MB prebuilt DLL with no HIPRT/Orochi licence files.
